# Vendored source

This runtime-only copy comes from `doggychip/dashboard-core` tag `v1.0.12`, commit `27f6d2327b5d90bb6916b83b4134dab08e747cdd`.

It is vendored because the Zeabur build policy rejects both Git (`EALLOWGIT`) and arbitrary remote (`EALLOWREMOTE`) npm dependencies. Non-runtime client, CLI, and test files were omitted. The original MIT license is included.
